sights.n: Kinjō Tetsuo Archive at Shōfūen, Haebaru (金城哲夫資料館・松風苑)
sights.address: 1384 Tsukazan, Haebaru, Shimajiri District, Okinawa, Japan (inside Shōfūen 松風苑)
sights.w: The family home of Kinjō Tetsuo, the Okinawan scriptwriter who created Ultra Q, Ultraman and Ultraseven for Tsuburaya Productions, kept as a small free archive inside the Shōfūen ryōtei restaurant his family runs. The Anime Tourism Association picked it for its '88 Anime Pilgrimage Sites' in 2017. Visits are by reservation; the town lists hours as 11:30–17:00.
sights.anime: Ultraman / Ultra Q / Ultraseven — birthplace archive of creator-scriptwriter Kinjō Tetsuo; Anime Tourism '88' site (2017)
